scripts.speaker: Auction Hall Guide
scripts.text:
Hello, would you
like to enter the
Auction Hall?

scripts.speaker: Auction Hall Guide
scripts.text:
Great! Well then,
I hope you have fun
and enjoy the auction~

scripts.speaker: Auction Hall Guide
scripts.text:
Alright then,
see you later.
If you change your
mind, please come
and enjoy the auctions~

scripts.speaker: Auction Broker
scripts.text:
Welcome to the Auction Hall.
Would you like to view the goods?

scripts.speaker: Auction Broker
scripts.text:
Very well.
Please take
a look, and see
What's being offered~

scripts.speaker: Auction Broker
scripts.text:
Very well, then.
If you change your
mind, then please
come and check
out the auctions~
